scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently --kill-others --names shared,api,web "npm run dev --workspace shared" "npm run dev --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace frontend
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace backend
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.build:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace backend
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace frontend && npm run build --workspace backend
scripts.lint: npm run build:shared && npm run lint --workspaces && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm test --workspace backend && npm run test:integration
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
